column1: Requests that have been deemed ineligible
Requests where the individual died of cause other than MAID

Explanatory Notes: This chart represents MAID deaths where the report was received by Health Canada by January 31, 2022. For 2021, this represents 9,950 MAID deaths and an overall total of 12,286 written requests. It is acknowledged that jurisdictions may report different numbers of total requests and outcomes for the various scenarios (ineligible, withdrawal, or individual died) based on their own methodology for receiving and counting requests. Refer to Data Limitations (Section 2.3) for an explanation of why referrals are not included in this table. Due to small numbers, some data have been suppressed to protect confidentiality (represented by dashes). MAID cases are counted in the calendar year in which the death occurred (i.e., January 1 to December 31), and are not related to the date of receipt of the written request. All other requests are counted in the year in which they are received. Cases of self-administered MAID are included in this chart. They are not identified by year or jurisdiction in order to protect confidentiality. 2019 and 2020 data is presented here for comparison purposes with 2021 data.
